correctness.rationale: The source's run decomposition gives the Pascal moment equations. Removing only the final row leaves an m by (m+1) matrix of rank m. The alternating binomial vector v_j=(-1)^j C(m,j) annihilates every retained row by the standard binomial identity and is primitive because its last coordinate is ±1, so it generates the complete integer kernel. Nonnegativity gives exactly the interval -T_even<=t<=T_odd and hence exactly 1+T_even+T_odd compatible words. A run-vector exhaustive engine and an independent direct-word subsequence-DP engine replay the result on substantial finite ranges.
